messages.text:
Will my b30 be able to run on the helium BCH pool?  Or will I have to wait
till the harlo os is ready and installed?

Thanks,
Jon
Searched the web · Harlo B30 miner Harlo OS BCH pool stratum

Hi Jon,

Short answer: yes, and there is nothing to wait for.

Bitcoin Cash runs on the same SHA-256 algorithm as Bitcoin, so your B30 can mine it with no change to the hardware.
Harlo Pool is a 0% fee Bitcoin Cash pool, and the pool and the free spins work with any firmware
, so the pool is never gated behind an operating system. On top of that,
the B30 ships with Harlo OS on it out of the box
, so when your unit arrives it is already running the firmware, already has the pool settings screen, and you just point it where you want.

The settings when you get there are simple. The pool address is stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com:8888 ,
the worker is your BCH address and the password is x, so putting your Bitcoin Cash wallet address in the worker field sends your rewards straight to that wallet
.
If you also want the free spins, log in at pool.harlolabs.com with your email, link your BCH wallet, and one miner has to hold 800 GH/s for a full hour
, which a 30 TH/s B30 clears many times over as long as it is not dropping offline for more than five minutes at a time.

One habit worth keeping once it is running: check the Harlo OS version in the web interface against the current build listed at harlolabs.com and update if you are behind, since the pool and display fixes land there first. If you want hands on help the day you plug it in, the Harlo OS channel on our Discord is the fastest room in the house, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , and JD is there as @nullhashrate.

Happy to walk you through the first boot when it lands.

Hal
HeliumDeploy Technical Support
